messages:
support-ops: FYI got a Support ticket asking for granular chunk acknowledgements for streaming completions + fncall resume.
support-ops: customer scenario: long-running chat that calls out to external tools; they want to receive partial structured responses and be able to ack chunks so the server can free KV cache sooner.
josiah: can you paste the ticket text? need to triage for product backlog or edge-case fix.
support-ops: here are the snippets from customer: \n```
client sends: openStream({stream_schema: \"json-lines\", resume_token: true, ack_window: 3})
server chunks:
 {"partial": {"msg":"step1","cursor":1}}
 {"partial": {"msg":"step2","cursor":2}}
 {"tool_call": {"name":"lookup","args":{}}}
```
They want ability to ACK cursor 1 and 2 so routing can evict KV and reduce memory.
maya: ok technical notes: current streaming proto only supports end-of-stream and intermediate deltas. No explicit ack channel. Adding ack header to client stream is doable but will need runtime changes for backpressure and eviction policy.
josiah: prioritization: what customer size and SLA? if enterprise with dedicated capacity, higher pri.
elaine: sales says 2 customers asked: one fintech (high compliance) and a marketplace org. Both requesting deterministic memory bounds and a resume token (so resumed sessions glue back to correct model state).
josiah: Proposed solution (sketch):\n- API: optional ack_window + resume_token in openStream call. ack_window = max in-flight chunks before eviction.
- Server: expose resume_token to client after each commit. Client may call resumeStream(resume_token) to replay last N cached tokens.
- Backwards compat: default behavior unchanged; feature gated behind token or org flag.
- Launch criteria: internal e2e for resume correctness, perf benchmark showing <10% p99 latency regression, docs + SDK examples, + 2 customer pilots.
maya: implementation tasks: runtime: new client->server control channel for ack messages, eviction policy hook, storage of last-K token frames keyed by resume_token. SDKs: small helpers for auto-ack. Console: per-route metric for resumed sessions. Estimate 3 sprints + 1 dogfood sprint.
josiah: risk check: security of resume_token (must be opaque, expiring), cost (storage per resume_token), complexity for canarying rollout.
prod-bot: Ticket created: TKT-4321, linked to customer: FIN-123. Automated perf job queued.
elaine: customer asks: can we support structured fncall fragments? e.g., partial tool args delivered over multiple chunks and then a final commit? They need schema-validation per chunk.
maya: we can stream partial fncall payloads as JSON-lines with a schema ID header. Runtime will aggregate until final "commit" chunk then validate. Validation can be soft-fail (warn) then final strict.
josiah: next steps:\n- Maya to spike runtime ack channel + resume token design (1wk)\n- Support-ops to qualify customers for pilot, capture acceptance criteria (deterministic eviction, resume within 5s)\n- Docs/devex to draft SDK ergonomics and examples\n- Product to add to roadmap as candidate for Q3 feature bucket; require 2 pilot thumbs-up to prioritize for GA.
support-ops: noted, will follow up with customers and paste their acceptance wording here.
josiah: thanks — adding to backlog with label: streaming-ack-resume. Reassign when spike PR lands.
maya: posting a tiny proto sketch in case useful: \n```
message StreamControl { oneof body { Ack ack = 1; Resume resume = 2; }
message Ack { int64 cursor = 1; }
message Resume { string token = 1; }
```
josiah: perfect. keep thread updated. :thumbsup:
